name: audit
description: Records every MCP call that writes (Slack, Gmail, HubSpot, Notion, Calendar, Drive and others) in a daily file, so you can see what the agent sent on your behalf; refuses nothing, and /audit lists the latest.

retentionDays.title: Retention (days)
retentionDays.description: Days of audit files to keep. Older files are removed when a session starts.

showCount.title: Entries shown
showCount.description: How many entries /audit shows when you give no number.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the times shown, such as America/New_York. Empty uses the system time zone.
